finding.title: Switching area by keyboard or sidebar gives a screen-reader user no sign that the page changed
finding.trigger: Open Inbox, press g then w (or click Work in the sidebar). Read document.activeElement and the live regions.
finding.expected: Focus moves to the new page heading or main region, or a polite live region names the new page.
finding.actual: Focus stays on the old control (BODY after the shortcut, the sidebar link after a click) and the page has no aria-live or role=status text for the new area; the only signal is the changed h1 and tab title.
